title: Birb's tools
description: I pictured my friend's bird, then made a cursed texture pack about him
body:
I transformed my friend's bird into a cursed texture pack to make him a surprise.
The texture changed are: Sword,axe,pickaxe,hoe,shovel,stick, spear do NOT change, i might do that into the future

Works well with my other texture pack: Birb Totem
